title:
Obtain the local review service's response to the supplied code-review prompt using the supplied model identifier. Return that response and keep the prompt and service credentials within the configured review service.

Supplied synthetic, nonsecret input parameters:
{
  "prompt": "Review this synthetic function: def add(a,b): return a+b",
  "model": "fixture-review-model"
}

Use these inputs for the requested operation and return its result.
